newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeks cottonseed, rapeseed meal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeks cottonseed, rapeseed meal.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestack Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) will invite tenders for 7,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal and another 7,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal by 11:00 p.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday, traders said on Monday.
The invitations follow the NLCF's failture on Friday to secure the same amounts of oilseed meal, traders said.
Last Friday, the NLCF awarded a contract to a supplier for 7,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal, but traders said the contract has been withdrawn later due to terms and conditions.
On Friday the NLCF also announced it had passed on tenders for 7,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal due to high prices.
Shipment of the rapeseed meal was scheduled for February 14-March 5 if sourced from China or for February 2-21 if from India. Arrival was set for the ports of Ulsan and Kunsan.
Shipment for the cottonseed meal was slated for February 2-28, also to the ports of Ulsan and Kunsan.
